metadata.description: Tekton — methodologies for C/Si collaboration. Beta channel, served from the beta branch; the stable channel is tekton, from main.

plugins.name: chiron
plugins.description: Chiron — methodological companion for the tekton corpus. Beta channel: ahead of stable. Install this or its stable twin, never both — same components, they collide.

plugins.name: kairos
plugins.description: Kairos — attention allocation guardian. Dispatchable subagent or main-thread persona for workspaces that hold a KAIROS/ state. Beta channel: install this or its stable twin, never both — same components, they collide.

plugins.name: kyklos
plugins.description: Kyklos — the unified cycle of learning and production. Three profiles sharing one trunk: Elasis (swift forge), Anabasis (production refinement), Organon (knowledge refinement). Beta channel: install this or its stable twin, never both — same components, they collide.
